story: Point Mugu State Park is located in the Santa Monica Mountains National Recreation Area in Southern California. It features oceanfront beaches, chaparral-covered mountains, and two major canyons with seasonal rivers. The park adjoins Mugu Lagoon, which is a protected area within Naval Air Station Point Mugu.
matters: The western terminus of the Backbone Trail, a multi-use long-distance trail extending nearly 70 miles across the Santa Monica Mountains, is located in the park.
name: Point Mugu State Park
